Tls.//MinimumVersion: Tls12 (default) allows TLS 1.2 and 1.3; set to Tls13 to require 1.3 only.

Headers.//HstsMaxAgeSeconds: 0 disables HSTS — the correct setting while still on a self-signed certificate.

RateLimit.//AuthRequestsPerMinute: Requests per source address to the credential endpoints. 0 disables.
